title: Impostures Intellectuelles (English: Fashionable Nonsense: Postmodern Intellectuals' Abuse of Science)

publication.publisher_or_container: Editions Odile Jacob (fr); St. Martin's Press (en, 1998)

verification.verification_notes: Confirmed publication (1997 French original, 1998 English) and that the book documents impenetrable jargon and misuse of scientific terms as a mode of unearned authority. Contested as criticism; used only as documented professional criticism, never as sole support for a universal claim.

limitations: Polemical source; the criticism is contested within the humanities.
